posts.title: The Age of Personal Software in Healthcare

posts.title: A Sense of Agency
posts.description: Growing up, I started noticing a difference in how people respond to problems. Some spend a lot of time complaining. Others begin trying to figure out what they can do about it. I recognise that second impulse in myself. I think of it as a sense of agency . You believe that what you do can change something about a situation.
